prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:

[action] Built a complete canvas game: mouse-aimed archer, hold left-click to draw (power bar + dashed trajectory), release to fire, balloons float up (pop for points), 3 hearts, 3 escaped balloons = game over, start/restart overlay, WebAudio synthesized sounds (draw, shoot, pop, lose, start), particle bursts, Google Fonts pixel font. Verified in headless browser: page loads, START clicks, balloons spawn, mousedown/mouseup fires an arrow (arrows:1), score/lives HUD update.
[result] game/index.html is complete and functional. Assumptions: single-shot power by hold duration; small balloons worth 20, big 10; lives lost only on balloon escape. Could not visually confirm pixels (screenshots unreadable to me), so visual polish is unverified.
[next] None — no second turn. Note: balloons spawn verified programmatically; audio plays only after user gesture.
